name: Mesocarb
summary: Mesocarb, sold under the brand name Sidnocarb or Sydnocarb and known by the developmental code name MLR-1017, is a stimulant medication which has been used in the treatment of psychiatric disorders and for a number of other indications in the Soviet Union and Russia. It is currently undergoing research trials for potential application in treating Parkinson's disease and sleep disorders. It is taken by mouth.
